text:
In the first scene, I feel a certain distance and curiosity. The closed glass wall separates me from the group within, turning their meeting into a kind of silent play I can only gaze at—an observer, not a participant. It makes me reflect on the many unseen meetings and decisions that shape the world, happening constantly behind transparent barriers.

In the second scene, I'm struck by the vibrant, almost playful energy of the R+D display. The wall invites me to think about innovation and progress, the meeting point of people and machines. Here, I feel inspired and intrigued, as if invited to probe the boundaries of what is known and what is possible.
